project_info.name: Kapoor Engineering Works (KEW)
project_info.vibe: Editorial magazine meets industrial brutalism. Bauhaus engineering catalog. High contrast, large display typography, rigid exposed grids, 1px hard borders, striking accents, intentional asymmetry.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[7vw] font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase leading-none
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-accent-primary font-bold

typography.custom_instructions: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Emphasize tracking-tighter for headings and tracking-widest for mono overlines. Use massive typography as a structural design element. Typography should feel loud but highly disciplined.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-black border-y border-black
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: When creating grids, set the container background to black and gap to 1px or 2px, and children to background white. This creates a flawless exposed 'blueprint' grid look.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Heavy use of hard borders. border-black border-2.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text. Use asymmetric column spans (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-8).

surfaces.cards: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-none transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:-translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#0A0A0A]

buttons.primary: bg-accent-primary text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-sm py-4 px-8 border-2 border-black rounded-none hover:bg-black transition-colors flex items-center justify-between group
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-text-primary font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-sm py-4 px-8 border-2 border-black rounded-none hover:bg-accent-primary hover:text-white transition-colors

surfaces.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-none px-4 py-4 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-accent-primary font-mono text-sm placeholder:text-black/40

components.navbar: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white border-b-2 border-black flex justify-between items-center px-4 md:px-8 py-4. Links must be uppercase mono. Add a solid bottom shadow if scrolling.
components.hero: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-between border-b-2 border-black. Top half: massive text 'INDUSTRIAL SOLUTIONS'. Bottom half: split grid with text description and a high-contrast industrial image.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. border-y-2 border-black py-4 bg-accent-primary text-black font-heading text-4xl uppercase overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap
components.projects_gallery: Large stark image grids with visible borders separating them. Images should have grayscale filters that turn colored on hover.
components.footer: Massive typography 'KEW.', strict grid layout for links, black background with white text.

hero_image.description: Massive industrial factory interior, moody lighting.

animations.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion. Keep it brutal: sudden slides, hard cuts, or fast unmasking rather than slow fades.
animations.hover_states: Instant, high contrast changes. Solid shadows appear instantly (no ease-in-out). Image filters shift from grayscale to full color.
animations.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium feel.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high. Black on white, White on Black. Accent color must be checked for readability.

Home: Hero: Editorial split. Massive 'KEW 07' text. Scroll down indicator.
Marquee: Infinite scrolling 'PRECISION MACHINING • HEAVY FABRICATION • STRUCTURAL STEEL'.
About snippet: Bauhaus grid. 19+ Years large number. 'Built on Iron, Driven by Precision.'
Services Strip: Accordion or hover-expandable brutalist list.
Projects snippet: Asymmetrical bento box of images.
Trust/Clients: Grid of logos with hard borders.
Contact CTA: Massive block color section (Safety Orange background, black text).
pages_structure.Products: Grid-based catalog. 4 categories: Roofing Sheets, MS Pipes, Structural Steel, Industrial Hardware. Use technical tables for specs instead of soft cards.
pages_structure.Services: Deep dives into Precision Machining, Heavy Fabrication, Machinery Overhaul. Use the raw metal and blueprint textures as backgrounds. Include technical numbers (01, 02, 03).
pages_structure.Projects: Masonry or strict grid gallery. Hover over text to reveal image (editorial interaction) or standard high-contrast cards.
pages_structure.About: Company story. Use oversized typography for the 2007 founding year. Show the factory interior image.
pages_structure.Contact: Hard-edged form. Input fields have thick borders, no border-radius. Embedded map with grayscale CSS filter. Floating WhatsApp icon.
pages_structure.404: Massive '404' outlined text. 'SYSTEM FAULT' or 'PAGE NOT FOUND' in mono font.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a brutalist, Bauhaus-inspired engineering site.
DO NOT use standard Shadcn card styles (no soft shadows, no border-radius). Override them with hard 2px borders, square corners, and solid box shadows.
Install and use: framer-motion, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, @studio-freight/react-lenis (for smooth scrolling).
Install fonts: next/font/google with 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono'. For heading font, use 'Archivo Black' or 'Bebas Neue' to give a massive, heavy industrial feel.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Images MUST be sourced from the 'media' object or local '/logos/' folder. Never use placeholders.
Create a responsive, mobile-first design, but utilize CSS Grid extensively for desktop layouts. The grid should be visually exposed using 1px or 2px borders.
